title: QUALITY CONTROL ANALYST - 2ND SHIFT
description:
At Guerbet, we build lasting relationships so that to enable people to live better. This is Our Purpose.

We are a global leader in medical imaging, offering an extensive portfolio of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, digital and AI solutions, for diagnostic and interventional imaging. As a pioneer in the field of contrast products since the last 100 years, we continuously innovate to improve the diagnosis, prognosis and quality of life of patients.

Customer Centricity, Cooperation, Audacity, Focus, and Responsibility are the values that we share and practice on a daily basis.

Working at Guerbet is not only being part of a multicultural team with nearly 3,000 people across more than 20 countries, but it is above all about playing a unique role in the future of medical imaging.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This person will actively participate in the company's Quality System to ensure that the physical and chemical analysis procedure is carried out on production materials, enabling the product to meet the required quality standards. This is a second shift position.

YOUR ROLE

  • Analysis of in-process product, finished product and raw material
  • Perform sample preparation, execute and interpret high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) analyse using Empower systems
  • Control the use and useful life of HPLC columns
  • Perform sample preparation, perform and interpret analyses using absorption spectrophotometry.
  • Perform sample preparation, execute and interpret titrimetry analyses in automatic titrators.
  • Sample identification by infrared
  • Review operational procedures
  • Develop procedures for new equipment
  • Record analytical results in the LIMS system
  • Perform/record OOS investigation
  • Understand, comply with, and respect HSE (Safety, Health, and Environment) procedures, instructions, and rules as part of your daily role and responsibilities, acting to ensure your own safety and contribute to the safety of others, always adopting safe behavior.
  • Exercise your commitment to HSE by participating in safety, health, and environment training and initiatives, and continually practice risk awareness in your daily work.

YOUR BACKGROUND

  • Experience in quality control, with good technical knowledge for analysis of in-process product, finished product, imported product and HPLC methods.
  • Degree in pharmacy or chemistry
  • Experience in pharmaceutical
  • Operational knowledge of liquid chromatography
  • GMP Good Laboratory Practices
  • Knowledge of European regulations related to the analysis routine.

WHY JOIN US

We offer continued personal development. When you join Guerbet, you:

  • Are choosing a global leader with recognized expertise in diagnostic and interventional imaging
  • Are joining our 3000 collaborators who are committed every day to offering innovative solutions to improve quality of patient’s life all over the world
  • Are joining a company where we value diversity of talents coming from various horizons

Do you want to help improve patients’ lives with us? We look forward to meeting you and continuing our story together!

We # Innovate # Cooperate # Care #Achieve at Guerbet.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Projeto "Software de Rastreabilidade via Blockchain de Logística Reversa Pós-Consumo", apoiado pela FAPESP. O objetivo é desenvolver uma solução digital para gestão logística e ambiental de resíduos sólidos, utilizando tecnologias como blockchain e contratos inteligentes, com foco em transparência, rastreabilidade e eficiência na logística reversa pós-consumo.

  • Coleta de Feedbacks & Documentação: interação com usuários, organização de tutoriais, FAQs e manuais de apoio.
  • Monitoramento de Indicadores: análise de métricas como tempo de resposta, número de falhas e nível de utilização da plataforma.

Requisitos

  • Formação técnica ou superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência de dados ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável Conhecimento Em

  • Docker/Kubernetes (diferencial).

Impacto

Ao integrar a equipe, você contribuirá diretamente para a melhoria da logística reversa de resíduos pós-consumo, redução de custos, aumento da eficiência para empresas e desenvolvimento sustentável, conservação ambiental e incentivo à economia circular.

Banco de Talentos: Oficial de Manutenção - Hospital Municipal Souza Aguiar

Esta é a sua porta de entrada para um futuro promissor no maior projeto de modernização de infraestrutura hospitalar do Rio de Janeiro.

Ao cadastrar seu currículo, você entra em nossa rede e poderá ser considerado(a) futuramente para todas as vagas que surgirem durante as próximas contratações.

Quem somos?

  • Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

Estamos buscando profissionais talentosos e experientes para nosso Banco de Talentos de Oficial de Manutenção. O objetivo é identificar e ter em nosso cadastro candidatos com sólido conhecimento em manutenção predial em geral, com experiência em um ou mais ofícios (como alvenaria, pintura, marcenaria, serralheria, etc.), preferencialmente em ambientes hospitalares. Você será um profissional essencial na manutenção da infraestrutura, garantindo a funcionalidade, segurança e estética das nossas instalações.

  • Estamos buscando profissionais talentosos e experientes para nosso Banco de Talentos de Oficial de Manutenção. O objetivo é identificar e ter em nosso cadastro candidatos com sólido conhecimento em manutenção predial em geral, com experiência em um ou mais ofícios (como alvenaria, pintura, marcenaria, serralheria, etc.), preferencialmente em ambientes hospitalares.

Dia a Dia

O profissional selecionado para vagas futuras poderá exercer atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva que envolvam:

  • Pintura: Preparar superfícies, aplicar tintas, massas, vernizes e outros produtos de acabamento.
  • Alvenaria e Acabamentos: Assentar tijolos, blocos, reboco, pisos, azulejos e outros revestimentos. Realizar reparos civis em telhados, lajes e calçadas.
  • Marcenaria: Analisar, confeccionar e reparar móveis e peças, trabalhando a madeira, armando partes e finalizando acabamentos.
  • Serralheria: Interpretar desenhos, realizar cortes em metais, aplicar técnicas de soldagem, modelar e montar estruturas metálicas, corrimões e grades.
  • Geral: Realizar pequenos reparos de alvenaria, hidráulica (simples) e elétrica (simples), e consertos de rachaduras e buracos. Organizar, limpar e manter o local de trabalho seguro. Seguir rigorosamente as normas de segurança no local de trabalho (incluindo o uso de EPIs) e procedimentos hospitalares. Auxiliar em outras tarefas de manutenção predial conforme a necessidade.

Local de trabalho

Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro.

Horário

Temos 2 modelos de jornadas, 44 horas semanais (segunda a sexta) e plantonista 12x36 (diurno e noturno).

Requisitos

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Fundamental Completo ou Segundo Grau Completo (dependendo da especialidade da vaga).
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência comprovada ou curso profissionalizante em uma das áreas de manutenção (pintura, marcenaria, serralheria ou alvenaria/pedreiro).
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento sólido nas técnicas do ofício principal (leitura de desenho técnico, soldagem, uso de ferramentas e equipamentos, etc.).
  • Habilitação Profissional (quando aplicável ao ofício).

  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente em equipe.
  • Proatividade e iniciativa para antecipar problemas e buscar soluções de forma autônoma.
  • Certificação ou treinamento em segurança ocupacional (NRs, como NR-35 - Trabalho em Altura, por exemplo) será considerado um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento prático de normas de segurança no local de trabalho.
  • Experiência prévia em manutenção predial em hospitais ou ambientes de saúde.

Benefícios

  • Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.

description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

A Equinix é a empresa global de infraestrutura digital®, operando mais de 260 data centers em todo o mundo. Líderes digitais utilizam a plataforma confiável da Equinix para reunir e interconectar a infraestrutura básica na velocidade do software. A Equinix permite que as organizações acessem todos os lugares, parceiros e possibilidades certos para escalar com agilidade, acelerar o lançamento de serviços digitais, oferecer experiências de classe mundial e multiplicar seu valor, ao mesmo tempo em que apoiam suas metas de sustentabilidade.

Uma carreira na Equinix significa colaborar em projetos que impactam o mundo, com infinitas oportunidades para aprender novas habilidades e crescer em diversas direções. Valorizamos a diversidade de pensamento e contribuição, e estamos comprometidos em proporcionar um ambiente de trabalho equitativo — essencial para os nossos valores e para o nosso sucesso.

Como um Analista de Customer Success Sênior na Equinix, o profissional atuará de forma estratégica em três pilares fundamentais para o negócio:

  • Relacionamento com Clientes Field Sales: prestará atendimento direto aos clientes das contas de Field Sales — clientes estratégicos e de grande porte da Equinix, garantindo uma experiência de excelência desde o primeiro contato.
  • Apoio ao time de vendas com foco em upselling: atuará lado a lado com a equipe comercial, identificando oportunidades de expansão e propondo soluções com melhor custo-benefício, sempre com foco nas necessidades do cliente.
  • Retenção e fidelização de clientes: será responsável por conduzir um onboarding eficaz e por manter um acompanhamento contínuo, analisando métricas, controlando a taxa de churn e adotando uma postura proativa na prevenção e resolução de problemas. O objetivo será garantir a satisfação do cliente, sua permanência e o interesse em novos negócios.

Descrição da vaga:

Integração de Clientes

Utilizará discernimento para adaptar a melhor abordagem de interação com os clientes, considerando suas necessidades e o escopo do projeto.

Seguirá a Metodologia de 3 Fases:

  1. Fase 1 – Pré-integração: Realizará atividades preparatórias com todos os clientes.
  2. Fase 2 – Reunião Inicial: Agendará, facilitará e conduzirá reuniões de início de integração.
  3. Fase 3 – Acompanhamento Contínuo: Estabelecerá uma cadência regular de contato para acompanhar a evolução dos clientes.

Poderá liderar integrações em diferentes regiões, em parceria com outros Gerentes de Sucesso do Cliente (CSMs).

Traduzirá processos internos de forma clara, alinhando expectativas e influenciando positivamente os clientes e stakeholders.

Relacionamento e Personalização

Interagirá com equipes multifuncionais e coletará informações detalhadas sobre os clientes para personalizar a experiência e entender sua direção estratégica.

Após o onboarding, acompanhará ações e tarefas conectando-as aos objetivos do cliente.

Identificará tendências e utilizará perguntas estratégicas para aprofundar o entendimento do negócio.

Gestão de Adoção e Sucesso do Cliente

Desenvolverá, manterá e acompanhará Planos de Sucesso do Cliente em diferentes escopos.

Promoverá a adoção de produtos e processos com base em tendências de uso.

Compartilhará conhecimento sobre os produtos da Equinix (atuais e futuros), capacitando os clientes.

Coletará e gerenciará feedbacks, propondo melhorias contínuas com base nas percepções dos clientes.

Atuação Estratégica e Colaborativa

Colaborará com as equipes de contas em discussões de pré-venda, atuando como defensora do cliente.

Garantirá transições suaves entre áreas internas.

Liderará projetos especiais com equipes multifuncionais, inclusive em contas globais.

Desenvolverá e implementará melhores práticas, mantendo contato proativo com os clientes.

Gestão de Problemas e Escalonamentos

Avaliará e priorizará problemas e escalonamentos, garantindo visibilidade e resoluções adequadas.

Atuará junto às partes interessadas para assegurar o cumprimento de políticas e procedimentos.

Comunicará resoluções e planos de melhoria com clareza e empatia.

Gestão e Retenção de Contas

Participará da gestão de contas em parceria com as áreas de vendas e gestão.

Apoiará o cumprimento de obrigações contratuais.

Identificará riscos de churn de forma proativa e contribuirá com estratégias de retenção.

Conduzirá revisões operacionais regulares e gerenciará projetos de acompanhamento.

Principais requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa.
  • Inglês avançado ( terá entrevista em inglês ).

Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Pós-vendas, Suporte Técnico ou Consultoria

  • Experiência em lidar com um portfólio diversificado e extenso de clientes B2B.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de sucesso do cliente (ex.: NPS , churn , CSAT, health score).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e CS Platforms (ex.: Salesforce ).
  • Experiência prévia em colaboração direta com o time de vendas .

Será considerado como diferencial:

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Reports To

Background

  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

Authority

  • The Instrument Technician is authorized to maintain Instrument assets and systems safely.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Dismantle and Reassemble Instrumentation Equipment
  • 1Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
  • 2Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.
  • 3Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
  • 4Identify, check and prepare components.
  • 5Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Monitor and Maintain the condition of Instrumentation Equipment.
  • 1Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.
  • 2Adjust with minimum disruption to any ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.
  • 3Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.
  • 3) Diagnose Faults in Equipment.
  • 1Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • 2Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
  • 3Carry out Visual, Close and Detailed inspections on ”˜Ex” equipment.
  • 4Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
  • 5Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.
  • 4) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
  • 1Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 2Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
  • 3Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 4Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 5) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Instrument Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Instrument/Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • COMP ex E’X’ course preferred.

Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta’s long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language.
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, gRPC, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Better Cotton does not use artificial intelligence or automated screening tools in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our People & Culture team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human‑led assessment experience.

Our Hiring Process

Initial Screening

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicants. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

Interviews

If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management.

Assessment And Testing

Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position.

Reference Checks

Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications.

Offer Stage

After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If selected, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details.

Better Cotton is a global not‑for‑profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments, and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand.

Being you @ Better Cotton

Better Cotton is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.   • Realizar pós-EVTE de contratos vigentes, avaliando resultados financeiros, operacionais e comerciais versus as expectativas originais;
  • Identificar gaps de performance e oportunidades de aumento de rentabilidade por cliente, região e segmento;

  • Mapear oportunidades de expansão de serviços e soluções B2B, com base em análise de mercado, benchmarking e retorno financeiro esperado;
  • Apoiar o time comercial na formatação de propostas de valor e business cases, contribuindo para fidelização e crescimento da base de clientes;
  • Colaborar no desenvolvimento e teste de novos modelos de negócio junto às áreas de Inovação e Engenharia;
  • Conduzir a implantação de projetos de novos negócios, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, escopo e metas financeiras;
  • Garantir alinhamento entre as áreas envolvidas, promovendo integração e visão de portfólio;
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e apresentações de resultado, consolidando os aprendizados e impactos obtidos.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlativas;
  • Experiência sólida em análise de viabilidade econômica, rentabilidade de contratos e gestão de projetos;

Visão da Empresa

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Resumo da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM HEMODINÂMICA que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor pelos seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  1. Participar de dar continuidade às atividades determinadas pela gerência e coordenação de enfermagem.
  2. Exercer a função assistencial, educativa, de pesquisa e social, em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem.
  3. Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e dificultam o processo de enfermagem.
  4. Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor, buscando o bem‑estar da equipe interdisciplina.
  5. Solucionar as intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente.
  6. Prestar assistência aos pacientes, atendendo suas necessidades básicas (higiene e conforto, apoio emocional), zelando pela sua segurança.
  7. Participar de Reuniões com a gerência, supervisão ou Coordenação de Enfermagem, quando solicitado.
  8. Participar da passagem de plantão dentro da sala operatória, checando organização da mesma, conferindo materiais, incluindo equipamentos necessários, ap (an) ate anestésico-cirúrgico e materiais que necessitam de data em dia.
  9. Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo CCIH de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP).
  10. Ser assíduo, pontual e disciplinado.
  11. Manter chefia direta informada sobre as intercorrências do serviço, solicitando da mesma, quando necessário, as devidas providências.
  12. Responsabilizar‑se por todos os materiais do setor, zelando pelo uso adequado.
  13. Comunicar ao Enfermeiro supervisor qualquer defeito ou anormalidades ocorridos com matérias e equipamentos em sala.
  14. Preencher diariamente o mapa de controle de temperatura da sala de cirurgia.
  15. Avaliar diariamente a necessidade de material permanente (Braçadeira de pressão não invasiva PNI, cabo de oxímetro, etc.) e comunicar à sua chefia imediata para reposição.
  16. Avaliar diariamente a necessidade de material descartável para consumo (campos de cobertura cirúrgica, campos de mesa auxiliar).
  17. Realizar diariamente a reposição dos impressos de sala cirúrgica.
  18. Usar adequadamente os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI), de acordo com ambiente e/ou tipo de material utilizado e norma regulamentadora NR32.
  19. Preencher diariamente no primeiro horário do plantão o check list da sala de cirurgia, repondo os materiais faltantes.
  20. Estar ciente quanto aos procedimentos que serão realizados na sala de hemodinâmica sob sua responsabilidade.

  • CONHECIMENTO EM PROCEDIMENTOS ESPECÍFICOS DE HEMODINÂMICA, CARDIOLOGIA.

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.

The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

title: Senior Customer Success Analyst ( Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo )
description:
Senior Customer Success Analyst (Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo)

Join to apply for the Senior Customer Success Analyst (Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo) role at Equinix .

Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Equinix is a global digital infrastructure company, operating more than 260 data centers worldwide. Digital leaders use Equinix’s reliable platform to connect and interconnect core infrastructure at the speed of software. Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners and possibilities to scale with agility, accelerate the launch of digital services, deliver world‑class experiences and multiply their value, while supporting sustainability goals.

As a Senior Customer Success Analyst, you will strategically drive three core pillars to the business:

  • Relationship with Field Sales customers: provide direct support to strategic, large accounts, ensuring an excellent experience from first contact.
  • Support to sales with a focus on upselling: work side‑by‑side with the commercial team, identifying expansion opportunities and proposing solutions that align with customer needs.
  • Retention and customer loyalty: lead an effective onboarding and maintain continuous follow‑up, analyzing metrics, controlling churn and proactively preventing and resolving issues to ensure customer satisfaction and continued engagement.

Integration of Clients

Use judgment to tailor the best client interaction approach, considering their needs and the scope of the project. Follow the 3‑phase methodology:

  • Phase 1 – Pre‑integration: Perform preparatory activities with all clients.
  • Phase 2 – Initial meeting: Schedule, facilitate and conduct initial integration meetings.
  • Phase 3 – Continuous follow‑up: Establish a regular cadence of contact to monitor client evolution.

You may lead integrations across regions in partnership with other Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Translate internal processes clearly, align expectations and positively influence clients and stakeholders.

Relationship and Personalization

Interact with cross‑functional teams, collect detailed client information to personalize experiences and understand strategic direction. After onboarding, follow up on actions and tasks linked to client goals. Identify trends and ask strategic questions to deepen business understanding.

Adoption and Customer Success Management

Develop, maintain and monitor Customer Success Plans across scopes. Promote product and process adoption based on usage trends. Share product knowledge to empower clients. Collect and manage feedback, proposing continuous improvements based on client insights.

Strategic Collaboration

Collaborate with account teams in pre‑sales discussions, acting as a customer advocate. Ensure smooth transitions across internal areas. Lead special projects with cross‑functional teams, including global accounts. Implement best practices and maintain proactive client contact.

Issue and Escalation Management

Assess and prioritize issues and escalations, ensuring visibility and proper resolution. Work with stakeholders to enforce policies and procedures, communicating resolutions and improvement plans with clarity and empathy.

Account Retention

Partner with sales and management for account oversight. Support contractual obligations, proactively identify churn risks and contribute to retention strategies. Conduct regular operational reviews and manage follow‑up projects.

Main Requirements

  • Completed higher education.
  • Advanced English (interview in English).
  • Prior experience in Customer Success, Post‑sales, Technical Support or Consulting.
  • Experience handling a diverse, extensive B2B client portfolio.
  • Knowledge of customer success metrics (NPS, churn, CSAT, health score).
  • Familiarity with CRM tools and CS platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Previous direct collaboration with the sales team.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in technology companies (SaaS, Cloud, Infrastructure or Data Center).

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

description:
A Clubbi é um marketplace B2B para pequenos mercados de bairro. Fornecemos uma nova forma de abastecer a loja: mais conveniente, aos melhores preços e com os melhores prazos de entrega.

Nossa visão é otimizar toda a cadeia de suprimentos e operações para este segmento do varejo, que representa um mercado de R$250Bi somente no Brasil.

A Clubbi foi fundada em 2020 e já chamou atenção de alguns dos melhores fundos de VC do Brasil e do Vale do Silício: Valor Capital, OneVC, Canary, Better Tomorrow Ventures. Em 2022, recebemos a rodada Series A, liderada por ALLVP e Nfx.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Nossa missão é fortalecer os pequenos varejistas como os maiores protagonistas do comércio na América Latina.

A gente acredita que por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para estes produtos.

Para ter sucesso neste objetivo, desenvolvemos uma cultura única e especial:

  • Despertamos da nossa realidade para vestir a camisa pelo nosso cliente
  • Desenvolvemos um time fora da curva
  • Não temos medo de errar, desde que isso nos ensine alguma coisa
  • Temos foco e somos obcecados por priorização e eficiência
  • Tratamos adultos como adultos, com autonomia e responsabilidade
  • Somos transparentes e não-hierárquicos
  • Nos preocupamos genuinamente com as nossas pessoas
  • Cuidamos para que a Clubbi seja um local incrível para trabalhar

Acreditamos que um ambiente de excelência, aprendizado rápido, foco obsessivo no cliente junto com muita colaboração e diversão permite a todos alcançar o seu potencial pleno e contribuir com nossa missão.

️ Principais Atividades

Você será responsável por liderar a área de Finanças da Clubbi, garantindo processos financeiros sólidos, reportes confiáveis e suporte estratégico para todas as áreas do negócio.

O desafio é estruturar controles e processos que sustentem nosso crescimento e tragam cada vez mais eficiência e precisão às nossas operações.

  • Ser o ponto focal da relação com nosso provedor contábil e garantir a precisão das demonstrações financeiras e fiscais.
  • Criar e aprimorar controles para o balanço patrimonial e DRE gerencial.
  • Implementar processos robustos de controle de estoques e contas a receber.
  • Conduzir o processo de planejamento estratégico da empresa e atividades de FP&A.
  • Gerir o fluxo de caixa, contas a pagar e a receber, assegurando conciliações e governança financeira.

title: Quality Engineer - Data Test Engineer (IDMC)
description:
Job Title

Quality Engineer - Data Test Engineer (IDMC)

Company: IBM

Introduction

In this role, you will work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), delivering deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients worldwide. Our delivery centers provide locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer at IBM, your technical skills will directly impact the quality of the software we create. You will help each agile iteration reach the next level, whether the testing is manual, automated, or cognitive, ensuring the best deliverables for our clients and IBM.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) .
  • Responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and accuracy of data across on‑premise and cloud environments.
  • Validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using Informatica IDMC.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to guarantee seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for data pipelines and workflows built with Informatica IDMC.
  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target systems.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.
  • Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Document test plans, test results, and findings in a clear and traceable manner.
  • Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.
  • Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and transparent communication.
  • Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.
  • Work closely with cross‑functional teams to support ongoing data governance and compliance initiatives.

Technical Responsibilities

  • IDMC Development and Testing:
    • Understand and create end‑to‑end mappings in IDMC using Filters, Routers, Joiners, and JSON functions.
    • Handle JSON parsing, JSON structures, and JSON strings using the Structure Parser in IDMC.
    • Apply basic Java to write and execute small code snippets when required.
  • Python Coding:
    • Develop functions to read and process data from various file formats.
    • Use libraries such as Pandas for data analysis, manipulation, and validation.
  • Azure Cloud Tools:
    • Utilize Azure Data Factory (ADF), PySpark, or similar technologies to support data integration and transformation testing.
  • Database and SQL Work:
    • Write and optimize SQL queries to validate data between source and target.
    • Ensure data accuracy and completeness within large‑scale datasets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Solid understanding of software development and delivery in a data‑centric environment.
  • Proficiency with Informatica IDMC and related tools.
  • Strong SQL skills for data validation and transformation.
  • Experience with Python scripting and data libraries (e.g., Pandas).
  • Familiarity with Azure Cloud technologies (ADF, PySpark, or similar).
  • Ability to interpret and draw system and architecture diagrams.
  • Understanding of modern cloud technologies and data governance principles.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Comfortable working collaboratively within an Agile environment.
  • Advance English is a must.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high‑quality work within deadlines.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and curious mindset with a passion for data quality.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

Seniority Level

Mid‑Senior level

Employment Type

Full‑time

Job Function

Information Technology

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting

title: Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain
description:
Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain

Cadre scientifique: ANR MEGA

Les glissements sous-marins géants km³) sont présents dans les séries sédimentaires Quaternaire des marges continentales passives. Si leurs âges coïncident avec des fluctuations eustatiques, il est encore difficile d’expliquer comment d’aussi grandes ruptures sont générées sur de faibles pentes (<2˚) en l'absence d'un facteur déclenchant tel qu’un séisme. Des hypothèses proposent le rôle de la dissociation des hydrates de gaz et de l’augmentation des pressions interstitielles. Le projet MEGA explorera ces hypothèses grâce aux premières modélisations reliant la stabilité des hydrates de gaz, les variations de pression/température sur le fond marin et la stabilité des pentes. Il s’appuyera sur une comparaison innovante des systèmes du Nil et de l'Amazone, leurs forçages climatiques différant au cours des cycles glaciaires-interglaciaires. En l’absence de cas historiques de méga glissements, MEGA propose de modéliser leurs conséquences en terme de tsunami sur les zones côtières.

L’objectif est de modéliser et simuler numériquement des tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements sous-marins géants en s'appuyant sur le couplage de deux codes numériques existants: Shaltop pour le glissement de terrain, et Freshkiss3D pour la propagation du tsunami.

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des géologues de L'Institut des Sciences de la Terre de Paris (ISTeP) et des mathématicien·nes de l'équipe projet ANGE inria Paris/LJLL.

  • Étude de stratégies de couplage numérique entre Shaltop et Freshkiss3D.
  • Simulation de différents scénarios de glissements de terrain géants sur des zones géographiques précises.
  • Déterminer le rôle de la stratification en température de l'océan

La personne recrutée pourra s'appuyer sur l'approche numérique développée lors d'une précédente collaboration (ANR ALBAMAR) et sur les résultats déjà obtenus dans le cadre de ce projet.

Lieux de travail :

ISTeP, Sorbonne Université, Paris. De courts séjours chez les partenaires du projet sont susceptibles d'avoir lieu (UMR Géoazur, UMR EPOC, Linnaeus University en Suède, Fluminense Federal University et Université d'état de Rio de Janeiro au Brésil).

Collaboration :

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec Sara Lafuerza (ISTeP), Nina Aguillon (LJLL/ Inria Paris), Jacques Sainte-Marie (Inria Paris) et Bernard Di Martino (Université de Corse).

Responsabilités :

La personne recrutée a la charge de développer le couplage numérique et prendra des initiatives pour communiquer les résultats obtenus aux partenaires du projet.

Pilotage/Management :

La personne recrutée pourra être amener à former un/une étudiante en thèse à la simulation numérique.

Principales activés :

  • Implémenter des scénarios de réaction de l'océan à un glissement sous-marin géant
  • Déterminer les paramètres pertinents
  • Présenter l’avancée des travaux aux partenaires
  • Proposer des améliorations de stratégie numérique

Activités complémentaires :

  • Participer à l'écriture des rapports
  • Initier à l'utilisation du code les partenaires du projet
  • Restauration subventionnée
  • Transports publics remboursés partiellement
  • Congés: 7 semaines de congés annuels + 10 jours de RTT (base temps plein) + possibilité d’autorisations d’absence exceptionnelle (ex : enfants malades, déménagement)
  • Possibilité de télétravailet aménagement du temps de travail
  • Équipements professionnels à disposition (visioconférence, prêts de matériels informatiques, etc.)

The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.

Your profile

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017, we build on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter, employing senior human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack to enhance output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has delivered billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e‑commerce, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs, accelerating results through high‑impact digital strategies that unlock revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

The Role

We are hiring a Design Director—a visionary leader with a strong design background, driving high‑quality design execution across various platforms and managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Lead 1–3 UI/UX engagements, focusing on branded e‑commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX and clear design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2–4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows; provide strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and escalation handling.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—marketers, strategists, developers, and clients—to develop project plans, understand business objectives and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative; provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

Qualifications

  • 3–6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies; at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills—color theory, hierarchy, composition, typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, detail‑oriented with strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Ability to provide constructive internal feedback and guide direct reports.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Variants) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator); bonus: familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Remote & Compensation

Fully remote role operating in EST time zone, 100% conducted in English. Benefits include flexible parental leave, remote‑first culture, growth opportunities, autonomy with accountability, and a high‑bar performance environment.

Equal Opportunity

Darkroom is an equal‑opportunity workplace—dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Médico do Trabalho
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Overview

Estamos em busca de um Médico do Trabalho que será responsável em contribuir para promoção da saúde e segurança da força de trabalho, a partir da prevenção, do controle e da eliminação de riscos no ambiente de trabalho com o objetivo de prevenir perdas relacionadas às pessoas e ao patrimônio material da empresa.

Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia!

Traga a sua energia para a Light!

Seus desafios serão:

Responsibilities

  • Realizar exames médicos ocupacionais e clínicos conforme os riscos dos postos de trabalho.
  • Atender emergências médicas e realizar encaminhamentos adequados.
  • Integrar-se à equipe de enfermagem do trabalho, promovendo saúde e segurança.
  • Avaliar acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, emitindo pareceres técnicos.
  • Acompanhar colaboradores acidentados, inclusive em ambiente hospitalar.
  • Analisar postos de trabalho para identificar e minimizar riscos à saúde.
  • Elaborar laudos e relatórios sobre acidentes, doenças e insalubridade.
  • Prestar primeiros socorros e organizar remoções em casos graves.
  • Promover ações de saúde com base em dados epidemiológicos.
  • Participar de auditorias médicas e do gerenciamento de saúde ocupacional.

Qualifications

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho com registro no Conselho Regional de Medicina - RQE.
  • Conhecimento sólido em legislação de Medicina do Trabalho, com ênfase nas Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) do Ministério do Trabalho, nas diretrizes dos Conselhos Federal e Regional de Medicina, da ANAM e do Ministério da Saúde.
  • Domínio de técnicas de gestão de saúde ocupacional, alinhadas às premissas do Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO) da empresa, com foco na prevenção de riscos e promoção da saúde dos colaboradores.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas e softwares de gestão de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho, para registro, análise e acompanhamento de dados ocupacionais.

What we offer

  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Vale Refeição
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de treinamentos
  • Wellhub

* Todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência ;)

Nosso propósito é transformar a sociedade por meio da nossa energia, levando desenvolvimento e bem-estar por onde passamos todos os dias. E fazer parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros, por mais de um século, só reforça a nossa contribuição com o crescimento econômico e social do país.

Somos uma das maiores empresas privadas do setor elétrico brasileiro que atua, por meio de uma cadeia de valor integrada nos processos de geração, transmissão e distribuição de energia para 31 municípios do Rio de Janeiro, além da comercialização de energia para todo o Brasil.

Aqui, os desafios são diários e queremos que os nossos mais de 4 milhões de clientes tenham sempre a melhor experiência de atendimento, com serviços de alta qualidade.

Temos um time diverso de colaboradores campeões, que seguem juntos, colocando em prática o nosso propósito. Gente que sonha grande, quebra barreiras e faz história. Afinal, cuidar da energia que transforma a vida de tanta gente faz parte do nosso DNA!

Duque de Caxias, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

  • Organizar a distribuição da equipe de trabalho, liderando equipes, definindo as tarefas a serem executadas e alocando nos setores;
  • Conferir e orientar os funcionários no correto preenchimento de Relatórios, durante as rondas no prédio e ao final do plantão;
  • Realizar checklist nos novos colaboradores conforme rotina estabelecida, esclarecendo sobre as normas disciplinares, instruções de trabalho, normas de segurança, visitação dos setores, visando adequada ambientação;
  • Conferir o abastecimento do material e distribuição quando necessário, checar o DML (depósito de material de limpeza) e carrinho funcional, para que o colaborador execute suas funções diárias;
  • Realizar o Checklist de limpeza em formulários específicos avaliando o resultado da limpeza/higienização, orientando a equipe quando detectada falha, assegurando o protocolo e padronização estabelecidos;
  • Monitorar a conduta disciplinar da equipe, orientando e corrigindo comportamentos inadequados, aplicando as punições cabíveis conforme código de conduta;
  • Atentar para a aplicação prática dos conhecimentos adquiridos nos treinamentos realizados no contrato, para multiplicação das práticas adequadas;
  • Garantir a correta utilização e distribuição do uniforme e EPIs, e orientar quanto ao adequado asseio pessoal dos auxiliares de limpeza, seguindo normas e procedimentos estabelecidos;
  • Preencher controle de EPI, registrando o equipamento disponibilizado ao colaborador, colhendo assinatura, conforme orientação a normas de segurança;
  • Verificar etiquetas dos produtos no estoque e diluídos, fazendo conferência de prazos de validade, conforme padrão estabelecido;
  • Monitorar o suprimento de materiais e equipamentos em estoque no contrato, sinalizar necessidade ou efetuar solicitações necessárias, realizar a conferência no ato do recebimento e organizar a alocação;
  • Receber e assinar os atestados dos colaboradores, encaminhando para o superior, para controle de faltas e tratativa adequada de abonos;
  • Monitorar assiduidade e pontualidade dos colaboradores através do acompanhamento da Folha e Cartão de ponto;
  • Higienizar o material e utensílios utilizados no plantão anterior, organizando e acondicionando em local específico para continuidade das atividades previstas;
  • Ler e registrar informações no livro de ocorrência, no início e ao final do plantão, visando adequada continuidade das atividades do contrato;
  • Fazer a passagem de plantão em conjunto com a liderança do outro plantão, fazendo a ronda nos setores, sinalizando as ocorrências, registrando as informações, visando adequada continuidade das atividades no contrato;
  • Fazer ronda nos setores orientando os auxiliares na execução das tarefas, na correta aplicação da técnica de limpeza, corrigindo postura, delegando atribuições e acompanhando a execução, a fim de avaliar o resultado conforme padrão estabelecido;
  • Encaminhar e acompanhar o funcionário, no caso de Acidente de Trabalho ou algum tipo de ocorrência médica, informando ao superior hierárquico, segurança do trabalho e os familiares sobre ocorrido;
  • Realizar a diluição de produtos químicos de limpeza corretamente, seguindo as recomendações de segurança do trabalho, bem como também as orientações fornecidas pelo fabricante do(s) produto(s), FISPQs e treinamentos aplicados;
  • Comparecer em audiência como prepostos, representando a empresa, em processos judiciais e administrativos, caso haja requisição do departamento jurídico;
  • Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Manager role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth‑stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e‑commerce marketplace, direct‑to‑consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high‑impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About The Role

We are looking for a highly innovative, data‑driven Email Marketing Manager, who’s motivated by the challenge of working with some of the fastest growing e‑commerce and digital brands. You will join a team of email, SMS and retention marketing industry experts to drive client revenue, partner with internal cross‑functional colleagues to go deeper on understanding our customer needs and insights with a specific focus on deepening retention and building loyalty. You will lead a cross‑functional team to build creative strategies in email and SMS campaign development to help our clients grow.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Spain, Mexico, Portugal, and Brazil.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands‑on retention experience.
  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI, etc.
  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
  • You’re used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
  • You’ve had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life

  • Serve as the primary retention lead for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a bi‑weekly basis, you will lead meetings with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email, SMS, loyalty and subscription programs.
  • Project manage and delegate campaign briefs to your team, consisting of both retention specialists and designers.
  • Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client to ensure campaign quality and accuracy.
  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.
  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Growth, Digital, and Marketplaces teams to develop cohesive campaigns that drive client growth.

Working at Darkroom

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
